mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve (10Y-2Y spread < 0) combined with rising unemployment signals a high risk of recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances following an inverted yield curve with rising unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 2% INDPRO drop.

mechanism_narrative: Steady growth in housing starts combined with falling unemployment signals a strong consumer-led expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances following steady HOUST growth and falling UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 0.5pp FEDFUNDS hike.

mechanism_narrative: Steady job growth combined with low inflation signals a Goldilocks economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances following steady PAYEMS growth and low CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 5% RSAFS drop.
